featured_project.title: CodeOps Studio
featured_project.text: An mobile integrated development environment (IDE) for Android OS.

timeline.title: The Inventor's Spark
timeline.text: Fascinated by rockets, I dedicated my time to researching how rockets systems operate. My first project was an electrolyzer, which ignited my curiosity for how rockets work.

timeline.title: The Shift to Code
timeline.text: My focus shifted from hardware to software. I found interest in learning advance programming concepts, building small programs, and exploring Android development. This change was primarily because my dad said my experiments were too dangerous and that I should do something safer.

timeline.title: Dependency Haven
timeline.text: At 17, I built Dependency Haven, a maven-inspired dependency resolver designed from scratch, capable of managing, resolving and downloading artifacts which was used by several developers.

timeline.title: Doing the Impossible
timeline.text: Using only my OPPO A1K, I built CodeOps Studio: a mobile-based integrated development environment (IDE) from the ground up. I saw this as a necessity to bridge the gap between mobile development and traditional desktop IDEs given that I had no access to a desktop computer.

timeline.title: Ground Zero
timeline.text: Around August 2025, I lost my dad after a 5 year long battle with haemorrhagic stroke. His passing left a void deeper than words can capture. I guess that is life for you, you never know 🤷‍♀️ regardless I believe if I play my cards right "Everything's gonna be okay."

timeline.title: What could possibly go wrong?
timeline.text: I'm currently focused on building working hybrid plugin ecosystem for CodeOps Studio, I have no idea how I will achieve this using my phone but I'll try.

resume.headline: CS Undergraduate · Software Developer · Open-Source Contributor
resume.summary: Self-taught developer based in Nigeria, best known for building CodeOps Studio: a mobile-based IDE for Android OS.

experience.text: Built and continue to maintain a full mobile IDE with syntax highlighting, linting, and CI/CD hooks. 300+ active users, v1.1.0 released, Android 8+ compatible.
Built a dependency resolver from scratch at 17, capable of resolving, downloading, and dexing libraries into Sketchware Pro-compatible formats.

education.text: Studying computer science at the University of Calabar, Nigeria.
